info.name: Diwan API (via gateway)
info.description:
Exercises every API the gateway exposes, with assertions, including security checks (forged headers, other users' data, admin-only paths).

Setup: import this collection and the environment file, then set `lambdaSecret` to ALEXA_LAMBDA_SHARED_SECRET from the .env file. Run the folders in order (Runner, or `newman run`): it creates two users and removes them again at the end.

Rate limit: login/register allow 5 requests per IP, then about one every 12 seconds. A full run uses all 5 - wait about a minute before running it again.

item.name: 1. Auth and access control
Register user B (second user, for isolation tests)

item.name: Device is gone from the list
Routes: normal user cannot add a route -> 403
Actuator is not served on the public port -> 403
User A cannot deactivate user B -> 403
User A cannot delete user B -> 403
User B deactivates their own account
Deactivated user B cannot log in
User B deletes their own account
User A deletes their own account
User A logs out (token is revoked)
The revoked token no longer works -> 401
